title: How much complex image data can a small tensor network keep?
rationale: A bond-2 matrix product state of normalized complex Fourier digit amplitudes retains mean held-out squared fidelity at least 0.90 and classification accuracy within five percentage points of dense amplitudes, while using at most 75% as many complex coefficients.

falsifiers.description: Mean signed claim margin is negative over five eligible seeds
